baseline_models.focus_anchor: The overt saying, the question about their khatb, and the vocative identifying them as mursalun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance recognizes commissioned agents but leaves the consequential affair behind their dispatch undisclosed, so it demands the sender-linked purpose and scope of their arrival.

activation_trace.role: Overtly produced speech turns recognition into an explicit demand for disclosure.
A grave consequential affair supplies the unknown object whose cause and scope are requested.
Dispatch or release identifies the addressees by commissioned movement and binds their affair to a sender.

changed_reading.before: A generic question about what the visitors want.
changed_reading.after: A formal demand that recognized envoys disclose the consequential commission for which they were dispatched.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins qala, khatb, and the messenger title in one direct address.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech about an affair becomes reciprocal clarification of a carried message: the addressees are not merely asked for a topic but invited to unpack the mandate their message carries.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over an affair makes the question the opening turn of mandate clarification.
Reciprocal address supplies the conversational channel through which the hidden assignment can be reviewed.
A bearer and carried saying link the speakers' verbal answer to an authorization beyond themselves.

changed_reading.before: A request for a short statement of purpose.
changed_reading.after: An opening for reciprocal unpacking of both the carried message and the authority or action attached to it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative ma khatbukum is directed to mursalun rather than answered by the speaker's own inference.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question can acknowledge that a grave event is pending while withholding judgment; a restraint branch under dispatch makes the speech a disciplined pause before conclusions.

activation_trace.role: Interrogative saying can suspend a supposition, keeping the speaker from fixing an answer prematurely.
The image of a momentous affair supplies urgency without itself determining what the affair is.
Deliberateness and verification counterbalance urgency, making direct inquiry the mechanism of restraint.

changed_reading.before: An alarmed reaction to ominous visitors.
changed_reading.after: A controlled question that names possible gravity while refusing to decide the matter before the envoys state it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The encounter begins as a report about descending guests and then marks the group as unrecognized; the focus address reclassifies the same figures by function as message-bearing envoys while their commission remains the unresolved variable.

activation_trace.role: Renewed speech as report frames the episode as news whose decisive content is still unfolding.
A person who inclines down as a guest supplies the visitors' first, socially legible classification.
Lack of recognition keeps personal identity unresolved and makes the later functional recognition consequential.
The consequential affair is what remains unknown after the visitors' role is recognized.
Message-bearing identity replaces the guest label and directs the question toward carried commission.

structural_cues: The sequence labels them honored guests in 51:24, an unrecognized people in 51:25, and sent ones in 51:31.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the three role labels; I infer that the focus marks a social-to-functional reclassification. Alternatively, messenger status may have been known earlier while only its explicit naming is delayed.

changed_reading.before: The host asks unidentified visitors why they came.
changed_reading.after: The host has recognized what kind of agents they are and now isolates the remaining unknown: which commission brought them.

context_deltas.mechanism: A covert movement to prepare food, its presentation, and the eating question fail to establish ordinary guest reciprocity; inward fear and verbal reassurance then give way to the explicit mission question as a second diagnostic.

activation_trace.role: Hidden lateral movement begins a material hospitality test before any direct interrogation.
Bringing the meal near makes participation immediately available and turns nonparticipation into evidence.
Literal taking of food supplies the expected bodily act whose absence prevents ordinary guest classification.
Fear falling inward registers the failed social test before the concern is spoken.
Anticipation of harm explains why reassurance must close the fear phase before purpose can be queried.
The grave affair becomes the explicit diagnostic object after material diagnosis proved insufficient.
Message-bearing status supplies a non-bodily explanation for why ordinary food reciprocity failed.

structural_cues: The movement from concealed preparation in 51:26 to 'will you not eat?' in 51:27 is followed by inward fear and explicit reassurance in 51:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preparation, presentation, eating inquiry, fear, and reassurance; I infer that nonparticipation breaks the guest circuit and motivates a mission-based diagnosis. Alternatively, the focus question may arise only after the birth announcement is complete.

changed_reading.before: A polite purpose question during a visit.
changed_reading.after: A second diagnostic that replaces failed bodily hospitality with direct inquiry into the visitors' nonordinary function.

context_deltas.mechanism: The envoys have already opened the household with joyful news that reverses barrenness and have attributed it to the Lord's wise speech; asking their khatb afterward separates that completed nurturing disclosure from a still-unspent sovereign commission.

activation_trace.role: News that visibly opens the face establishes a benevolent message already delivered before the focus question.
The youth of the promised boy gives the first message concrete household content.
Infertility makes the birth disclosure a completed reversal rather than a vague greeting.
Sovereign lordship locates the carried saying within an authoritative chain of command.
The non-dominant growth and nurture mapping resonates with the promised birth and marks the benevolent part of the commission.
Right-judging wisdom makes the already delivered saying credible while leaving room for a distinct wise assignment.
The consequential affair names the residue not exhausted by the household announcement.
Message-bearing plurality permits one delivered message to coexist with a further commission.

structural_cues: The visitors announce a knowing boy in 51:28 and close that exchange with 'thus your Lord said' in 51:30 before the focus question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies birth news, infertility, both sovereignty and nurture mappings under ر ب ب, and closure by attributed speech; I infer that the focus asks for the mission left over after that message. Alternatively, it could seek elaboration of the same announcement.

changed_reading.before: Abraham asks the envoys for their first and only reason for coming.
changed_reading.after: He asks what mission remains after their private, life-giving message has already been delivered and authenticated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The answer repeats the dispatch root and supplies a destination-group characterized by culpability, so the focus vocative anticipates the exact predicate by which the speakers explain themselves.

activation_trace.role: The passive envoy title poses commissioned dispatch as the category needing specification.
The grave affair is held open until destination and target make it concrete.
Their overt reply completes the question-answer speech pair without narrative delay.
First-person dispatch mirrors the focus title and converts a recognized role into a stated assignment.
A defined human collectivity supplies the mission's destination rather than an abstract topic.
Culpability characterizes the destination group and turns purpose-disclosure toward judgment.

structural_cues: The vocative 'sent ones' in 51:31 receives the immediate first-person answer 'we were sent' in 51:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical mirror and destination; I infer that the question functions as formal elicitation of a commission formula. Alternatively, the repetition may be ordinary narrative cohesion without formal force.

changed_reading.before: The messenger title is merely polite identification.
changed_reading.after: The title is the interrogative key that the reply inflects into 'we were sent,' then completes with destination and culpable target.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dispatched figures answer that they were dispatched and then state a purpose involving another dispatch, now of solid clay material; the focus title thus marks a relay node rather than only a courier endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Successive groups or movements make the plural envoys available as one stage in a serial dispatch.
Their received dispatch supplies the incoming leg of the commission chain.
A further act of sending supplies the outgoing leg and creates the recursive relay.
Solid stone gives the outgoing dispatch material force rather than merely verbal content.
Mixed clay specifies the dispatched material and grounds the relay in a tangible medium.

structural_cues: The passive envoy title in 51:31 is followed by 'we were sent' in 51:32 and a purpose clause with 'we send' in 51:33.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three linked forms of ر س ل and the material object; I infer a nested dispatch in which the envoys mediate execution. A live alternative assigns the second sending directly to the higher sender while the envoys only report it.

changed_reading.before: The mursalun are couriers who terminate a chain by delivering words.
changed_reading.after: They occupy a relay inside a chain of release: sent agents disclose or mediate a further sending of material force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dispatched material is marked or assigned in the sender's presence for people defined by crossing limits; both mappings of the marking root make the commission look indexed and imposed rather than indiscriminately released.

activation_trace.role: A visible distinguishing mark supplies an index by which dispatched material can be recognized as assigned.
The split root's imposed harm image supplies the coercive side of the same target-specific assignment.
Nearness and presence locate the specification with the sender rather than as an improvisation by the envoys.
Sovereign authority supplies ownership of the target specification and authorization of the mission.
Crossing the limit supplies the criterion correlating assigned force with its recipients.
The grave affair is revised from undirected calamity into an assignment with encoded bounds.
Commissioned movement carries the sender's specification toward its designated recipients.

structural_cues: 51:34 places the marked material with Abraham's Lord and directs it to the limit-crossers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinguishing-mark and imposed-harm branches, sender proximity, and a recipient criterion; I infer that marking functions like mission routing. Alternatively, it may describe only the material's physical appearance or prior designation.

changed_reading.before: The question asks what broad catastrophe the envoys bring.
changed_reading.after: It asks what sender-specified, recipient-indexed operation governs their dispatch.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exit is actively produced before the destructive remainder, and a search contracts the protected population to one household; the mission therefore contains a discriminating safety boundary as well as punitive force.

activation_trace.role: Causing movement outside supplies the rescue operation that precedes exposure to the judgment.
Heart-settling assent identifies the class selected for extraction.
Finding after search turns protection into an evidential census rather than a vague exception.
The household image sets the concrete social unit across which the safety boundary is drawn.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the protected side of the operation's boundary.
The grave affair expands to include the ordered separation that constrains its destructive phase.
Dispatch now denotes a bounded operation with extraction and judgment rather than a single undifferentiated act.

structural_cues: 51:35 narrates extraction before 51:36 reports finding only one protected household.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active extraction, belief language, finding, one household, and safety language; I infer that these are boundary conditions of the disclosed commission. Alternatively, extraction may be a separate divine act rather than part of the envoys' mandate.

changed_reading.before: The khatb is a single destructive event.
changed_reading.after: The khatb is a sequenced operation whose rescue census and safety boundary are integral to how judgment is executed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping rather than the ordinary morphology of qala. Prior inward fear makes trembling and instability produce a real changed reading anchored at the focus utterance, but downstream prose must call it a cross-mapped resonance, never a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus qala resolved through the supplied non-dominant ق ل ل target, beside the direct khatb question.

activation_trace.role: Trembling from fear colors the overt utterance as speech emerging after bodily unsettlement.
Instability and motion make direct questioning a move toward regained cognitive footing.
Fear occurring inwardly supplies the concealed unsettlement that the later speech can stabilize.
Expected harm gives the tremor resonance a visible narrative anchor rather than free association.
Naming the grave affair converts residual instability into a bounded object of inquiry.

changed_reading.before: A wholly calm administrative question unrelated to the earlier fear.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the question is also the act by which an inwardly shaken host regains footing and turns fear into articulate investigation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the syntax plainly favors khatb as affair and mursalun as envoys, while the cited branches open marriage proposal and suitor correspondence. The immediately preceding boy, wife, old age, and infertility keep the echo anchored and worth carrying; downstream prose must present it only as a lexical afterimage of the fertility scene, not as the verse's translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus khatb and mursalun activate marriage-domain branches immediately after the household fertility exchange.

activation_trace.role: Seeking marriage lends the mission question a courtship-domain afterimage as the birth exchange closes.
The form-distant branch linking marital status with suitor correspondence intensifies the transition from family negotiation to envoy commission.
The promised youth supplies the prospective family outcome around which the echo gathers.
The explicit wife figure gives the marriage-domain activation a nearby household anchor.
Old age sharpens the impossible-family setting from which the administrative question pivots.
Infertility supplies the blocked reproductive state reversed by the preceding message.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an abrupt, purely administrative break from the birth scene.
changed_reading.after: The administrative mission question retains a faint marriage-and-family afterimage, making the pivot out of the fertility scene audible without changing its primary sense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the later left sign back through a branch where a thing's 'saying' is its indication. It remains anchored in focus qala and the explicit sign residue of 51:37, but downstream prose must describe retrospective semantic resonance, not claim that the focus verb grammatically means 'to signify.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus qala under its indication branch, with the asked-about khatb later leaving a visible sign.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication as its saying lets the spoken inquiry anticipate a mission whose material remainder will testify.
The grave affair supplies the event that can pass from verbal disclosure into durable evidence.
Leaving an effect behind supplies persistence after the envoys and their spoken answer depart.
A visible sign turns the disclosed mission into a nonverbal witness available to later observers.
Anticipation of harm identifies the future audience for whom the material answer remains legible.
Painful punishment specifies what the enduring sign warns about and therefore what it silently communicates.

changed_reading.before: The question and answer are a one-time private conversation.
changed_reading.after: The question inaugurates an answer that will outlive the speakers as a material sign, retrospectively making the event itself 'say' what their mission was.

strongest_changes: Because the birth announcement is already delivered and authenticated, the focus asks for the envoys' residual commission rather than their first purpose.
The same figures move from honored guests to an unrecognized group to recognized envoys, leaving mission content rather than agent type as the final unknown.
The immediate reply and purpose clause create a dispatch relay: sent agents state that they were sent toward a culpable group in connection with a further material sending.
Marked targeting and prior extraction revise the grave affair into a discriminating operation with recipient and safety boundaries.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is a hinge between a completed life-giving household message and a still-hidden punitive public commission. Split-root and branch-distant evidence also preserves three contained afterimages: speech stabilizing fear, fertility language shading the mission pivot, and a spoken answer becoming a durable sign.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammar may assign the sending of the stones and the extraction directly to the higher sender rather than to the envoys as executing agents.
The ق ل ل tremor and marriage-domain activations may be packet-enabled resonances without intended semantic force in the focus wording.
The marking language may indicate physical appearance or prior designation rather than an active routing mechanism.
